field.name: group_method
field.doc: 🔩 Distribution of the load over the bolt group of the plate (EN 1993-1-8 3.12): Elastic is the vector method with the polar moment of the bolts, InstantaneousCentre is the plastic method with the load-deformation law of the bolts about the instantaneous centre of rotation.

enum.name: BoltGroupMethod
enum.doc: 🔩 Method for the force on each bolt of a bolt group: elastic vector method or instantaneous centre of rotation.
